answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across agents: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), while detecting a managed swarm applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation and escrow slashing. Thus a river of aliases cannot reach the zenith of influence; any fable of cheap duplication is economically disproven.
